title: Better pictures on phones
items: Phones: pictures open full screen with who sent them and their message at the bottom. Tap once to see just the picture, tap again to bring everything back.
Phones: zooming is much easier. Pinch and the spot under your fingers stays put, double-tap to zoom in or out, and drag to look around.
Phones: swipe a picture up or down to close it.
Phones: hold a picture for Save, Forward, Share, Copy Link, Open in Browser and Jump to Message.
Phones: React right from the picture.
